subject: Statement-modifier foreach over an ELEMENT does not alias: `$_ = "w" for ($h{k})` writes nothing
description:
DONE s365 (3df21d0). The two lowering sites peeled DIFFERENT wrappers off the foreach list, so the AST verdict never fired for the modifier spelling. One shared peeler (Pl::Parser::_foreach_list_unwrap) now serves the alias rewrite, the single-scalar wrap and VarAnnotator's veto; the applier (_apply_foreach_alias_rewrite) is anchored at the outermost call so a wrong head guess is a no-op, not an inner box.

Widened beyond the filed scope, in the same helper: element access THROUGH a ref ($r->{k}, $$r{k}, ${$r}{k} -> p-gethash-deref-box / p-aref-deref-box) and subscript CHAINS ($h{a}{b}, $r->{a}[0], $a[0][1] -> the outer access's plain box head) — shapes NEITHER spelling aliased before.

Tests: 4 rows + an inverse guard in Pl/t/foreach-aliasing-01.t (15 rows, 17 s).
Remaining gap: MULTI-element element lists, both spellings -> #267.
